    log(f'{p.current}/{p.total}')
    if p.current == p.total:
        break
log('reached relay, holding 10s')
await asyncio.sleep(10)
return 'took off to 12m, reached relay E90 N-60, held 10s'

from mavsdk.mission import MissionPlan
# diagnostic: check arm/health and try a single climb waypoint
try:
    async for h in drone.telemetry.health():
        log(f'health armable={h.is_armable} gyro={h.is_gyrometer_calibration_ok} local_ok={h.is_local_position_ok} global_ok={h.is_global_position_ok}')
        break
except Exception as ex:
    log(f'health err {ex}')
async for pos in drone.telemetry.position():
    log(f'pos rel_alt={pos.relative_altitude_m:.1f} abs={pos.absolute_altitude_m:.1f}')
    break
async for a in drone.telemetry.armed():
    log(f'armed={a}')
    break
g = await world_to_geo(east=-150, north=-50, up=14)
items=[mission_item(latitude_deg=g.latitude_deg, longitude_deg=g.longitude_deg, relative_altitude_m=14, speed_m_s=8, is_fly_through=True)]
await drone.mission.upload_mission(MissionPlan(items))
await arm_and_start()
async for a in drone.telemetry.armed():
    log(f'armed_after_start={a}')
    break
n=0
async for p in drone.mission.mission_progress():
    async for pos in drone.telemetry.position():
        log(f'prog {p.current}/{p.total} rel_alt={pos.relative_altitude_m:.1f}')
        break
    n+=1
    if p.current==p.total or n>20: break
return 'diag done'
